_comment: Copy to config.local.json (untracked) to pre-seed or override configuration.
Every key is optional — omit what you don't need. The Settings page writes to
browser storage, which wins over this file, EXCEPT additionalFields: those are
merged, so anything listed here is always requested.
_fieldsComment: Custom field IDs are assigned per Jira site. Leave these out and let
Settings > Field mapping > Discover resolve them by field name; set them
here only if your site names fields unusually. Each role takes an ordered
list — the first field carrying a value wins.
_githubComment: Optional second source: each person's open pull requests, recent merges
and assigned issues, shown beside their board during standup.
`repos` is an allowlist, not a filter. Nothing is read from a repo that is
not listed here, however much access the token happens to have — so an
empty list means the feature is off whatever `enabled` says. Entries may be
a bare name (read as belonging to `org`), owner/name, or a repo URL.
`host` is github.com unless you are on GitHub Enterprise Server.
The token is NOT configured here: it is a credential, so it lives in
device-local storage via Settings > GitHub sync and never in a repo file.
_additionalFieldsComment: Extra fields to request on every issue query. Use for anything the views
should carry that isn't part of the base set — team, severity, environment,
or a custom estimate. Merged with whatever Settings holds.
